name: คลินิกทันตกรรมธนาเด็นทอลคลินิก

summary_en: Thana Dental Clinic is a dental facility located in Bangkok. The clinic currently holds a perfect 5-star rating based on 5 total reviews and maintains a trust score of 58.4.
